_comment: Discord integration for the launcher, read live (no launcher release needed to change these). verifyUrl = the bot's OTP verify endpoint. inviteUrl = your Discord invite. codeUrl (optional) = where 'Get a code in Discord' sends the user (the bot's DM). oauthStartUrl/oauthPollUrl (optional) enable the smoother browser 'Log in with Discord': set them to https://<domain>/oauth/start and https://<domain>/oauth/poll once the bot has DISCORD_CLIENT_ID/SECRET + OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI set and the redirect is registered in the Developer Portal. Leave them blank to keep using OTP codes. Empty verifyUrl = the launcher shows Log in with Discord but says linking isn't switched on yet.
